facts.statement: Comahuesaurus is a genus of sauropod dinosaur belonging to the family Rebbachisauridae.
facts.quote: Comahuesaurus (meaning "Comahue lizard", after the region in which it was found) is a genus of sauropod dinosaur of the family Rebbachisauridae.

facts.statement: Comahuesaurus lived during the Early Cretaceous, specifically from the Aptian to Albian stages, in the Lohan Cura Formation of Argentina.
facts.quote: It was found in the Lohan Cura Formation in Argentina, and lived during the Early Cretaceous (Aptian to Albian).

facts.statement: The type species, C. windhauseni, was named in honor of Anselmo Windhausen for his contributions to the geological study of Patagonia.
facts.quote: The type species is C. windhauseni, named for Anselmo Windhausen, who contributed significantly to the geological study of Patagonia.

facts.statement: The holotype of Comahuesaurus consists of a single neural arch from a lower-back vertebra.
facts.quote: The holotype of Comahuesaurus, MOZ-PV 6722, consists only of a single neural arch from a vertebra of the lower-back.

facts.statement: Abundant material from at least three individuals includes 37 caudal vertebrae, partial dorsal vertebrae, a sternum, a coracoid, a complete humerus, an ilium, a complete pubis, five ischia, femora, a tibia, and a fibula.
facts.quote: Bones from at least three individuals were excavated from the type locality and they include: 37 caudal vertebrae, three partial dorsal vertebrae, part of a sternum, a coracoid, a complete right humerus, part of an ilium, a complete pubis bone, five ischia, two left and three right femora, part of a tibia, and a left fibula.

facts.statement: The humerus of Comahuesaurus measures 67.5 cm in length, while the femur measures 113 cm.
facts.quote: The authors did not provide a full size estimate for Comahuesaurus, but they did describe the humerus as being 67.5 cm long and the femur as being 113 cm long.

facts.statement: Comahuesaurus possessed a reduced hyposphene-hypantrum system, a trait shared with more derived rebbachisaurids but not yet fully lost in this species.
facts.quote: It shared the reduced hyposphene-hypantrum system that would characterize more derived rebbachisaurids, but hadn't yet completely lost this structure.

facts.statement: Fossil remains belonging to at least three individuals were found in the Lohan Cura Formation in southern Neuquén Province, Argentina.
facts.quote: Sus restos fósiles, pertenecientes al menos a tres individuos, se han encontrado en la formación Lohan Cura en el sur de la provincia del Neuquén, Argentina.

facts.statement: The bonebed preserving Comahuesaurus remains is believed to have been deposited rapidly by a single catastrophic event, likely a flash flood from an ephemeral river.
facts.quote: The bonebed which preserves all known remains of Comahuesaurus is believed to have been deposited rapidly in a single catastrophic event by an ephemeral river.

facts.statement: Comahuesaurus lived from 119.57 to 110.1 million years ago during the Aptian to Albian stages.
facts.quote: Time range: Aptian to Albian (119.57 to 110.1 million years ago)
